summary: R. Sathyanarayana (1927–2020) was an Indology scholar who earned a Master's in chemistry from the University of Mysore. He taught at Sarada Vilas College from 1949 to 1984 and served as President of the Indian Music Congress.
R. T. Vyas is an Indologist who served as General Editor for Gaekwad's Oriental Series (attested 1988) and as Director of the Oriental Institute, Vadodara, from 1993 to 1994.

R. Thangaswami Sarma (1924–2000) was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied at Annamalai University and Madras Sanskrit College. He held positions at Presidency College, Chennai, the Adyar Library and Research Centre, and Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute.

R. Venkatraman is an Indology and history/archaeology scholar who completed a PhD at Madurai Kamaraj University (1975–1980) under N. Subrahmanian and N. Jagadeesan. He served as a Reader at Madurai Kamaraj University (attested 1990).

Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941) worked in philosophy, religious studies, and other fields. He studied at St. Xavier's Collegiate School (~1875–1876) and University College London (~1878–1880), and founded Visva-Bharati University and the Sino-Indian Cultural Society.

Rachael Margaret Griffiths works in Tibetology and computational fields. She completed her DPhil at the University of Oxford in 2020, held a postdoc at the Austrian Academy of Sciences (2021–2023), and held a post at EPHE in 2024.
Rachael Wiseman is a philosopher who studied at the University of York. She held a position as Reader at the University of Liverpool in 2023.

Rachel H. Pang works in Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Virginia and was Lester D. Coltrane III Assistant Professor of Religious Studies at Davidson College (attested 2019).

Rachel Van Meter Baumer (1928–1995) was an Indologist who earned her PhD from the University of Pennsylvania (1964) under Thomas Welbourne Clark. She held posts at Michigan State University, University of Minnesota, and University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa.

Rachelle M. Scott is a scholar of Buddhist studies and religious studies who completed her dissertation at Northwestern University under George D. Bond and Robert Launay. She served as Associate Professor at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.

Rade Uhlik (1899–1991) was a linguistics and Indology scholar who studied Germanistics at the University of Belgrade. He worked as a translator at Tanjug and as a custos at the National Museum of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Radha Burnier (1923–2013) worked in Indology and philosophy after studying at Kalakshetra and Banaras Hindu University. She served as Director of the Adyar Library and Research Centre from circa 1954 to 1980.

Radha Krishna Choudhary (1921–1985) was a history and Indology scholar educated at Tej Narayan Banaili College and Patna University. He taught at Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University (1974–1984) and Ganesh Dutt College, and founded K. P. Jayaswal Archaeological Museum.

Radha Kumud Mukherjee (1884–1963) was an Indology and history scholar who studied at the University of Calcutta. He held posts at Banaras Hindu University (~1916–1917) and Maharaja's College, Mysore (~1917–1921) as Head of the Department of History.

Radhey Kishori is a scholar in computational fields and Indology. Positions held include faculty at Dr. MPS Group of Institutions (2014–2015), Research Fellow at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi (2015–2017), and Assistant Professor at IITM (2022–2024).
Radhika Herzberger is an Indology and philosophy scholar who completed her PhD at the University of Toronto (1982) under Bimal Krishna Matilal. She became Director of Rishi Valley School circa 1982.

Radoslav Katičić (1930–2019) was a linguist and Indologist. He studied at the University of Zagreb and under Paul Thieme, later holding a post at the University of Vienna (~1977–1998) and membership in the Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts.

Rafal Stepien works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. He completed his PhD at Columbia University under Chün-fang Yü and Bernard Faure, and held positions at Wadham College (2012–2013) and Harvard University (attested 2015).

Rafał Felbur is a Buddhist studies and sinology scholar. He studied at Stanford University as a PhD candidate under doctoral supervisor Paul Harrison and was also taught by John R. McRae and Luis Oscar Gómez.
Raffaele Catà is a scholar of philosophy and Indology who completed a laurea at the University of Bologna (2011–2012) under supervisor Manlio Iofrida and co-supervisor Saverio Marchignoli.
